items.difficulty_reason: 71 行、归纳论证：先把「两个函子互逆」化为单位与余单位两个伴随映射是同构；再引人「对象支撑在至多 n 个仿射开集之并的闭子集上」这一假设并对 n 归纳——n=0 时对象为零、由拟凝聚模到模的包含函子全忠实且正合推出另一个也为零；归纳步用「沿一个仿射开集与其补作 distinguished triangle」把 n 化为 n-1 与单个仿射情形，后者由两条 coherator 引理解决。承重步骤（约化到伴随映射、归纳切分、基例）都在 span 内；5 处引用（3 同章、2 跨章）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-argument-proves (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1701-1726

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the reduction to two adjunction maps being isomorphisms, the induction on the number of affine opens needed to support the objects, and the induction step handled by cutting with an affine open and using the coherator statements (source lines 1728-1798)
